purpose: Teach: 倉敷/ストライク/ワルツ/アイアン/鉄筋/蝋/シンデレラ/タンゴ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、修学旅行で倉敷行ったろ?
lines.en: You went to Kurashiki on your school trip, right?
lines.style: Bright, testing curiosity. Leans forward slightly. Quick rhythm, like she already knows the answer and wants to see if he'll admit it. Playful challenge underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、野球部でストライクとれたな、桜
lines.en: You scored a strike in baseball, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment, almost deflecting. Not quite meeting her energy. Warm but guarded — like he's complimenting her without wanting the spotlight back.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ダンス部でワルツやってんだろ?
lines.en: You do waltz in dance club, don't you?
lines.style: Pressing gently. Slight smile in the voice. Faster than before — building momentum, enjoying watching him shift in his seat. Teasing but not mean.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族でゴルフ行ってアイアン使ったろ?桜
lines.en: Your family went golfing and you used an iron, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her pace now. Quieter, more careful. Like he's offering her something back — a secret he noticed. The slightest hesitation before her name, like it matters that he says it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、鉄筋アパートだろ?
lines.en: Your place is a reinforced concrete building, right?
lines.style: Direct observation, testing him now. Quicker rhythm. Slight narrowing of focus — she's watching to see if he knew she was watching. Sarcasm threaded through but not unkind.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、誕生日の蝋燭吹き消したろ?桜
lines.en: You blew out your birthday candles, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Smaller, quieter. Almost tender underneath the rhythm. Hesitant — like he's sharing something he shouldn't know. Gentle landing on her name, like a secret.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、シンデレラの映画好きだろ?
lines.en: You like that Cinderella movie, don't you?
lines.style: Quiet observation. A small smile buried in there. Not accusatory, but intimate — like he's offering back what he's noticed. Slow on the final phrase, letting it breathe.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽でタンゴの単元やったろ?桜
lines.en: You covered tango in your music class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Close now. Soft attack, almost breathless. The words come like a confession — like he's admitting to noticing her, piece by piece. Gentle hold at the end.
